class.name: OcgSelect3dInteriorsensitivepointset
class.brief_description: This class handles the selection of arbitrary point set with internal type of sensitivity. The main principle is to split the point set given onto planar convex polygons and search for the overlap with one or more of them through traverse of BVH tree.
class.description: ! This class handles the selection of arbitrary point set with internal type of sensitivity. ! The main principle is to split the point set given onto planar convex polygons and search ! for the overlap with one or more of them through traverse of BVH tree.

method.name: Select3D_InteriorSensitivePointSet
method.description: Splits the given point set thePoints onto planar convex polygons

method.name: GetPoints
method.description: Initializes the given array theHArrayOfPnt by 3d coordinates of vertices of the whole point set

method.name: Size
method.description: Returns the length of vector of planar convex polygons

method.name: Center
method.description: Returns geometry center of planar convex polygon with index theIdx in the vector along the given axis theAxis

method.name: Swap
method.description: Swaps items with indexes theIdx1 and theIdx2 in the vector

method.name: CenterOfGeometry
method.description: Returns center of the point set. If location transformation is set, it will be applied

method.name: NbSubElements
method.description: Returns the amount of points in set

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
